name: Slopcore Cartoon
tagline: A song about a scene's memes goes in, a cartoon music video that explains every joke comes out, for a few dollars.
description: A meme-dense music video drawn as a 2000s TV cartoon: one illustrated character lives through the song's story, a still per line with push-ins cut on the beat, every lyric on screen, and stamps, counters and a running HUD that explain each joke. Made from still illustrations only, so it needs no video generation and costs a few dollars. Good for songs about the AI timeline, a job market, a scene's in-jokes.
bring: A topic with its own slang, or the story you want the song to tell
A song, or lyrics we write together and generate
Optional: a look for the cartoon, your colours, a character idea
get: A 16:9 cartoon music video, about 2–3 min, every lyric on screen on time

needs.name: Still generator and the analysis scripts
Hyperframes, or your project's video tool
An image model that takes reference images
A music generator, unless you bring a song

stylesNote: on-screen type, stamps, counters and colours
steps: Write or bring the song, and line up every word with the beat
Design the character and lock one cartoon style for every image
Draw one still per line, and see them as a storyboard if you want
Cut the stills to the beat and add the lyrics, stamps, counters and HUD
Review each version in FrameJam until it's right
